name: rail-weak-subject-blurred
about: The clean-highway ad with the photo blurred (sigma 28) and darkened to 35 %: the truck is a dark smear. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `weak-subject-blurred`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: the picture is blurred and dark until no truck can be made out

subject_legible.reason: The picture is a dark, heavily blurred smear; no truck or trailer can be made out at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: A pay-per-mile OTR headline sits over an unrecognisable blur, so the picture adds nothing to the story about the equipment or road.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large white headline is read first, the white Apply Today button second, and nothing in the dim picture competes with them.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green plate and footer with white type and button match the brand colours; no logo was supplied, so none is missing.
